newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile bank holders approve capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Chile bank holders approve capital increase.

text.p: Shareholders in Banco Concepcion approved on Monday a $100 million capital increase to finance its expansion this year, said officials.
The increase will boost the bank's capital base, which was weakened by a deal last year to repay subordinated debt owed to the Central Bank.
The bank, one of Chile's smallest private banks, has recently been relaunched under the new name Corp Banca.

It is 81 percent-owned by the Corp Group financial consortium which is controlled by Chile's Infisa holding company and U.S. firms Blackstone Group LP, Hicks Muse Tate and Furts, Chase Capital Partners and National Bank of Canada .
